title: Projektive Geometrie 2 (TUM, Modul MA3204)
description: After successful completion of the module the students are able to apply advanced algebraic techniques (like Tensor or Clifford Algebra) to geometric Problems and decide what tools are most appropriate for a specific situations. They are also able to apply combinatorial methods (oriented matroids, polytopes) to certain geometric problems. They understand the interplay of geometric, combinatoric and algebric structures in selected examples. 5 ECTS, angeboten unregelmäßig, Version 2024w, verantwortet von Richter-Gebert, Jürgen.
